_why: Flag-OFF goldens for tests/test_channel_neutral_prefix.py. REGENERATED 2026-09-15 at the merge of R44 (#749) and round 46, deliberately, for two prompt changes that landed on two branches: (1) R44 moved the `Today's date:` line out of the system prompt into the per-turn <turn_context> block, so the head is DATE-INVARIANT and these goldens no longer rot at local midnight; (2) round 46 (contract C9, A10) made the Document Generation section name `generate_data_file` and `generate_audio` — two tools added in ONE change so the provider prompt-cache lineage moves exactly once — and it no longer tells the model its file appears in 'the document pane', a web-only surface that exists on neither iOS nor WhatsApp; the diet copy moved with it (pinned by tests/test_format_intent_contract.py and tests/test_requested_format_reaches_the_model.py). `_freeze()` still normalises a `- Today's date: …` line on both sides should one ever return, and test_no_golden_contains_a_calendar_date keeps a calendar date out of the fixture. Regenerate only for a deliberate prompt change. REGENERATED AGAIN 2026-09-23, VOICE ONLY, deliberately, for toup-voice R2 (RT-9): the voice surface contract's rule 1 (ANSWER IN THIS TURN, FROM THE SNIPPETS) gained one standing exception — a person's CURRENT role or affiliation spends the one allowed fetch on the organisation's own current page (faculty/staff directory) and says plainly when a source describes a former role — because on the recorded 2026-09-22 call the caller had to challenge a professor's stated affiliation (R2 investigation RT-9: an old snippet against the organisation's current faculty page). Every other channel's sha and full text are unchanged (verified before writing); flag ON is still one prefix for every channel. REGENERATED AGAIN 2026-10-03, VOICE ONLY, deliberately, for PR-13 (P11, voice call of 2026-10-02): the voice surface contract's rule 1 gained two sentences — the request is a speech transcript, so resolve an obvious mis-hearing from context before searching (with a deliberately generic example, not the call's own words) and say which reading was used; a word that makes sense as said is kept as said — because the agent searched the literal ASR text 'officer in LLM in U of T' and answered it. Every other channel's sha and full text are unchanged (verified before writing). REGENERATED AGAIN 2026-10-05, every channel EXCEPT voice, deliberately, for the voice round's D-P4 (fast path vs card): the flag-off Runtime Context job rule now opens with the fast path — if the User Brain, this conversation or stable knowledge answers it, answer now with no tool and no job — and declares the job as 2–6 steps with the last one writing the answer. Exactly that one line moved in each full-text golden (verified by diff before writing); voice's sha and full text are unchanged because its branch of that rule is the voice one. REGENERATED AGAIN 2026-10-06, voice + web + app ONLY (the flag-off channels that carry a Media Playback section), deliberately, for the voice round's D-T1 (problem 3): each of the three Media Playback sections (voice, web/app, neutral) gained ONE rule naming the new `media_control` tool — to stop, pause, resume or skip what is playing, call it; never tell the user to tap the player; never say it stopped before the tool answers — because the 2026-10-06 call's delegated «استاپش کن» reached an agent with no tool that could stop music and it apologised while the song played. Exactly that one added rule line moved in the voice, web and app full-text goldens (verified by diff before writing); every other channel's sha is unchanged; the neutral section's copy of the rule is flag-ON only and is covered by the one-prefix tests.
